major.regulatory_reference: Important protocol deviation under FDA's December 2024 draft guidance (Protocol Deviations for Clinical Investigations of Drugs, Biological Products, and Devices); base deviation definition per ICH E3(R1). Requires expedited IRB/sponsor reporting.
required_capa_elements: Retraining on the specific procedure or safeguard that failed
Reassessment of the affected subject(s) where clinically feasible
An added monitoring checkpoint to catch recurrence before it reaches a subject
A named responsible party and a completion timeline

minor.regulatory_reference: Not-important protocol deviation under FDA's December 2024 draft guidance; no expedited reporting requirement, but should still be logged and trended.
required_capa_elements: Documentation of the deviation and its no-impact rationale in the site file
A named responsible party for closing the log entry
Trending across the site to confirm this stays isolated rather than becoming a pattern

technical.regulatory_reference: Root-cause sub-type, not an official FDA/ICH category (see data/labels.md Regulatory basis). Escalates to the major pathway only if the underlying failure is shown to have reached a subject.
required_capa_elements: Root-cause investigation of the equipment or system failure
Verification that no subject or data was actually affected before closing as technical-only
An added monitoring checkpoint (e.g. alarm, redundant check) to catch recurrence
A named responsible party and a completion timeline

administrative.regulatory_reference: Root-cause sub-type, not an official FDA/ICH category (see data/labels.md Regulatory basis). Escalates to the major pathway only if the documentation gap changed what a subject was told or could decide.
required_capa_elements: Retraining on the documentation or delegation requirement that was missed
Verification that no subject-facing information was affected before closing as administrative-only
A named responsible party and a completion timeline

unreported.regulatory_reference: Reporting-compliance gap, orthogonal to the FDA importance/intentionality axes (see data/labels.md Regulatory basis) -- the underlying event should also be separately triaged into one of the other four categories once identified.
required_capa_elements: Retrospective classification and filing of the originally-missed deviation report
Investigation into why the reporting workflow failed to flag it
An added monitoring checkpoint in the reporting workflow itself
A named responsible party and a completion timeline
